_meta.name: English (extractor template)

Audio command '%{tag}' rejected: this is: Audio command '%{tag}' rejected: this is a secondary window — open it on the spawning window instead.
Backend has no audio source — connect a: Backend has no audio source — connect a DAW to listen.
Browser ingress is idle — these settings: Browser ingress is idle — these settings only take effect once a track has its Take chip on (mic routed via the browser).
DAW-style keyboard shortcuts and mouse-w: DAW-style keyboard shortcuts and mouse-wheel behaviour. Affects the timeline body, ruler, overview strip, and transport keys.
Disable auto-restart — Foyer will never: Disable auto-restart — Foyer will never tear down the stream on drift, only on a network drop.
Drop an Ardour session here, or edit lau: Drop an Ardour session here, or edit launcher.jail in config.yaml to browse somewhere else. Run foyer config-path to find the file.
Drop every saved window for the current: Drop every saved window for the current monitor layout. Use this if you see weird slot numbers (Window 7 with no Window 2-6) — stale entries from dev sessions get wiped and the next + New window starts from Window 2 again.
Flash 'Window N' on every open window so: Flash 'Window N' on every open window so you can match labels to physical screens
Hide the metronome strip (click engine s: Hide the metronome strip (click engine state is unaffected)
Higher-rate streaming uses lossless raw: Higher-rate streaming uses lossless raw PCM (Opus is capped at 48 kHz). The sidecar resamples engine PCM to the rate you pick when it differs from the project.
How much audio the shim's per-stream ing: How much audio the shim's per-stream ingress buffer holds before draining into Ardour's record source. Bigger absorbs more browser GC + WS reorder jitter at the cost of higher live-monitoring latency. Recordings are auto-shifted for this depth, so only the foreground mix you hear through the engine is delayed. 80 ms suits a tunnel; loopback / LAN setups commonly drop to 20–30 ms. This value also doubles as the record-stop cushion — anything still in flight when you press stop has at most this much time to land before the engine halts. Takes effect on the next Listen / record stream you open.
IPC + one engine process cycle + record-: IPC + one engine process cycle + record-write. The ingress buffer (next section) is added on top, so this number doesn't need to include it. Defaults to 100 ms which suits both the in-process dummy backend and a small-buffer JACK setup. Drop to ~90 ms on a tight buffer (JACK 64 samples); raise to 150+ on a loaded tunnel.
Missing translations fall back to Englis: Missing translations fall back to English.
Monitor the master bus in your browser: Monitor the master bus in your browser
Open this session from Session → Open: Open this session from Session → Open
Opus tops out at 48 kHz — the stream wil: Opus tops out at 48 kHz — the stream will automatically fall back to raw when you start a higher-rate listen. Switch codec to raw for predictable behavior.
Plays a sequence of brief 4 kHz clicks o: Plays a sequence of brief 4 kHz clicks out the egress audio (your speakers) and listens for the reflection on the ingress (your mic). The measured speaker→mic round-trip is the GROUND-TRUTH capture latency that the empirical echo math can't see directly. The result becomes the suggested Manual capture offset. Auto-starts Listen and opens a temporary mic stream if neither is already on, then restores their previous state. ~3 s total.
Reopen the audio stream when sentinel ev: Reopen the audio stream when sentinel events arrive more than this many ms after their matching audio frame. 0 = never auto-restart.
Reopen when sentinel drift exceeds %{ms}: Reopen when sentinel drift exceeds %{ms} ms while transport is paused.
Secondary windows ask their Primary to s: Secondary windows ask their Primary to spawn the new window — same family, fresh slot.
Show the dedicated click strip docked to: Show the dedicated click strip docked to the master bus
Signed millisecond offset added on top o: Signed millisecond offset added on top of the empirical browser↔server round-trip the server measures from your ingress packets. Use this to dial in any residual the echo math can't observe — typically the mic-to-browser-stack hop and any platform output-latency that's under-reported by the browser. Positive shifts recordings earlier (longer _capture_offset); negative shifts later. Sing along to an existing track, eyeball the offset in the timeline, and dial this until the new take lines up. Live — applies on the next packet without restarting the stream.
Spawn a new browser window attached to t: Spawn a new browser window attached to this Foyer session. Audio stays on this (Primary) window.
Start foyer-cli with --jail <dir> to ena: Start foyer-cli with --jail <dir> to enable the session picker.
Strips flex to fill the container: Strips flex to fill the container
Strips stay at the density's pixel width: Strips stay at the density's pixel width; mixer scrolls horizontally if needed
This browser tab/window's place in the m: This browser tab/window's place in the multi-window family. All windows share session state; audio I/O is owned by the spawning (Primary) window.
This sidecar has no backend spawner conf: This sidecar has no backend spawner configured.
Toggle the Hidden button in the toolbar,: Toggle the Hidden button in the toolbar, or edit launcher.jail in config.yaml to point at a directory with projects.
Tuning for the browser→shim audio path. Drives both the ingress buffer depth (Ardour shim) and the empirical capture-offset stack.
UI language for this browser. Each conne: UI language for this browser. Each connected client picks its own; multi-client sessions can run in mixed languages.
Unauthenticated guest attempted '%{tag}': Unauthenticated guest attempted '%{tag}' — you must sign in first.
When you hit stop while recording browse: When you hit stop while recording browser audio, Foyer waits before the engine actually halts so the last in-flight bytes reach Ardour's record source. Total delay = capture + network + backend + ingress buffer depth; the first two are measured live (browser baseLatency + ingress one-way median), the last two are tunable in this section and the next. Last computed breakdown shows in Diagnostics → Timing.
